name: pharma_intelligence
description: Curated public facts from FDA CDER 2025 approvals, HERNEXEOS original-approval evidence, and an EFPIA 2026 industry chart. Source caveats remain visible; no patient records or pipeline forecasts are invented.

datasets.name: source_documents
datasets.description: Public evidence provenance, including original URLs, checksums, and capture dates.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Stable source reference identifier; not a model review decision.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Publisher document title.

fields.name: publisher
fields.description: Organisation publishing the evidence.

fields.name: publication_period
fields.description: Report edition or original approval scope; distinct from observation period.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Original public source URL.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: SHA256 of the exact downloaded source bytes.

fields.name: retrieved_date
fields.description: Date of source capture, not the date of the reported event.

datasets.name: drugs
datasets.description: 46 distinct products in FDA CDER novel drug approvals for calendar year 2025.

fields.name: drug_id
fields.description: Local stable identifier derived from the FDA trade name.

fields.name: brand_name
fields.description: FDA-listed drug trade name; combination products remain one listed drug.

fields.name: active_ingredient
fields.description: Active ingredient text as published; combinations are not split into approval events.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for the product fact.

datasets.name: approval_events
datasets.description: 46 original US FDA CDER approval events; not all FDA actions or global approvals.

fields.name: approval_id
fields.description: One row in the FDA CDER 2025 novel-drug list.

fields.name: drug_id
fields.description: Drug covered by this original approval event.

fields.name: approval_date
fields.description: Original FDA approval date in the selected 2025 list.

fields.name: regulator
fields.description: Regulator and centre; these records cover FDA CDER only.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: Approval jurisdiction; not a worldwide approval claim.

fields.name: approved_use
fields.description: Published use at original approval; not a current prescribing recommendation.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for this approval event.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Source table and row locator.

fields.name: source_quality_note
fields.description: Unresolved publisher text issue; an empty value is not independent clinical verification.

datasets.name: trials
datasets.description: One published original-approval trial evidence subset, not a complete trial registry.

fields.name: trial_id
fields.description: Public trial registry identifier.

fields.name: drug_id
fields.description: Drug evaluated in the selected approval evidence.

fields.name: trial_name
fields.description: Trial name in the FDA snapshot.

fields.name: sponsor
fields.description: Company identified in the FDA snapshot.

fields.name: design
fields.description: Detailed source design; see source_quality_note for conflicting summary text.

fields.name: population_description
fields.description: Bounded original-approval efficacy population, not all trial enrollment.

fields.name: evidence_patients
fields.description: 105 patients in this FDA efficacy evidence subset, not patient-level records.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for the trial evidence.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Source section used for curation.

fields.name: source_quality_note
fields.description: Unresolved design wording or scope issue requiring source review.

datasets.name: trial_cohorts
datasets.description: Two disjoint prior-treatment cohorts in the selected 105-person efficacy population.

fields.name: cohort_id
fields.description: Stable key for one disjoint prior-treatment cohort.

fields.name: trial_id
fields.description: Trial containing this approval evidence cohort.

fields.name: prior_her2_adc
fields.description: Yes or No for prior HER2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate treatment.

fields.name: patient_count
fields.description: Cohort denominator for ORR; not the responder denominator used for DOR.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for the cohort denominator.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Table header establishing the denominator.

datasets.name: trial_results
datasets.description: Four published endpoint percentages, with explicit cohort and endpoint denominators.

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: One trial cohort and endpoint result.

fields.name: cohort_id
fields.description: Cohort to which the endpoint applies.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: ORR or DOR_GE_6_MONTHS; these endpoints have different denominators.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Published percentage; never sum or take an unweighted average across endpoints or cohorts.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Percent, represented on a 0 to 100 scale.

fields.name: denominator_count
fields.description: ORR uses all cohort patients; DOR uses responders (53 or 15).

fields.name: ci_lower
fields.description: Published lower 95% confidence bound for ORR; null when not reported.

fields.name: ci_upper
fields.description: Published upper 95% confidence bound for ORR; null when not reported.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for the reported endpoint value.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Table and footnote establishing endpoint scope.

datasets.name: trial_demographics
datasets.description: Eleven aggregate demographic categories across four overlapping dimensions; no individual patient records.

fields.name: demographic_id
fields.description: One demographic dimension and subgroup in the overall efficacy population.

fields.name: trial_id
fields.description: Trial whose overall efficacy population is described.

fields.name: dimension
fields.description: Sex, Race, Ethnicity, or Age; each dimension describes the same 105 people.

fields.name: subgroup
fields.description: Source subgroup label, including Missing where reported.

fields.name: patient_count
fields.description: Subgroup count; do not sum across demographic dimensions.

fields.name: reported_percent
fields.description: Source rounded percentage; retained without recalculation.

fields.name: denominator_count
fields.description: Overall efficacy population denominator of 105.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Source for the demographic fact.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Source table establishing the subgroup counts.

fields.name: source_quality_note
fields.description: Source table versus figure discrepancy retained for review.

datasets.name: industry_observations
datasets.description: Five regional chart shares for sales of new medicines launched during 2020-2024.

fields.name: observation_id
fields.description: One indicator, geography, and observation period.

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: new_medicine_sales_share, not total pharmaceutical market share.

fields.name: geography
fields.description: Source chart region; Europe Top 5 is France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the UK.

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: First year of the chart observation period, not report publication year.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last year of the chart observation period.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Chart share on a 0 to 100 percent scale; only comparable within the same scope and period.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Percent of the chart-defined sales distribution.

fields.name: market_scope
fields.description: New-medicine launch cohort scope; not the overall drug market.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: EFPIA report containing the chart; underlying chart attribution is IQVIA MIDAS.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Original PDF page and chart locator.

fields.name: source_quality_note
fields.description: Source indicator and period scope; nearby market-growth figures describe a different indicator.
